name: CreateDomain
docs:
```sql
CREATE DOMAIN name [ AS ] data_type
        [ COLLATE collation ]
        [ DEFAULT expression ]
        [ domain_constraint [ ... ] ]

    where domain_constraint is:

    [ CONSTRAINT constraint_name ]
    { NOT NULL | NULL | CHECK (expression) }
```
